verdict.rationale: Whether user data can be excluded from AI model training is a fair question for an AI app builder, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a training opt-out, a data-usage policy, or a no-training guarantee. Security scanners, row level security, and enterprise controls are adjacent features and do not address model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
